31924-XIV.s: This bill sets the supplementary budget (slotwet) adjustments for the 2008 budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, including appropriation changes per policy article and operational service units. It also allows the 2008 annual report to deviate from certain Comptabiliteitswet 2001 presentation requirements.
q: Notwithstanding Article 54(1) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the annual report of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for 2008 may limit the per-policy-article insight in the accountability statement to parts c through f of that paragraph.

In afwijking van artikel 54, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 geldt voor het jaarverslag van het ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit voor het jaar 2008, dat het in dat artikellid bedoelde inzicht per beleidsartikel in de toelichting bij de verantwoordingsstaat beperkt kan blijven tot de onderdelen c tot en met f van dat artikellid.

31924-XVI.s: The bill sets the final budget adjustments (slotwetmutaties) for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2008, including departmental and agency budget changes. It also allows the ministry's 2008 annual report to deviate from certain Comptabiliteitswet 2001 reporting requirements as part of a government experiment.
31924-XVI.j: The memorandum explains that the annual report changes follow from a government experiment on improved accountability and budgeting, agreed with the Tweede Kamer.
q: Notwithstanding Article 54(1) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the annual report of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2008 may limit the per-policy-article insight in the accountability statement to parts c through f of that paragraph.

In afwijking van artikel 54, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 geldt voor het jaarverslag van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2008 dat het in dat artikellid bedoelde inzicht per beleidsartikel in de toelichting bij de verantwoordingsstaat beperkt kan blijven tot de onderdelen c tot en met f van dat artikellid.

32500-XVII.s: The bill formally establishes the 2011 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Youth and Family, setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros with entry into force on 1 January 2011. The explanatory memorandum describes youth care, child protection, and family policy priorities without creating new delegated rule-making or oversight changes.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of Youth and Family (XVII) for the year 2011 belonging to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Jeugd en Gezin (XVII) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

33174-(R1974).s: The bill approves, for the Kingdom, the 2010 Protocol amending the Convention on mutual administrative assistance in tax matters, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It also withdraws certain reservations for the European part of the Netherlands, Aruba, Sint Maarten and the Caribbean Netherlands, and sets a limit of three years on retroactive effect for Aruba and Sint Maarten.

parties: Asks how many outgoing and incoming tax information requests were made, honoured or refused, and on what grounds, to gauge whether exchange is effective.
How many of these requests have been honoured, how many have been refused, and on what grounds?
Hoeveel van deze verzoeken gehonoreerd zijn en hoeveel van deze zoeken geweigerd zijn en op welke gronden?
Asks which grounds still allow refusal, what confidentiality safeguards exist, which limits on use of information were lifted, and how privacy-sensitive data protection levels are assessed.
For what reasons may a request still be refused from now on?
Om welke redenen mag een verzoek voortaan nog wel worden geweigerd?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State approves the Protocol amending the Convention on mutual administrative assistance in tax matters but asks that the explanatory note on Article V be supplemented, since it does not clearly show which changes are made to Article 21. The minister's reply states that the explanatory note has been supplemented accordingly and that the Koninkrijk passages on reservations and the Kingdom position were edited.
concerns: The explanatory note on Article V of the Protocol does not sufficiently show which changes are made to Article 21 of the WABB Convention and should be supplemented so it is readable on its own.

33400-XVII.s: This bill fixes the 2013 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation in thousands of euros, with entry into force on 1 January 2013. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were found.
q: The budget statement of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2013 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33805-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting appropriations and expenditure lines through the supplementary budget (Najaarsnota). The explanatory memorandum details budget shifts across articles, including training and workforce subsidies and transfers to agencies and ZBOs.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33940-XVI.s: The bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) and the budget statement for its agencies, with mutations in expenditure and revenue in thousands of euros, effective from 1 June 2014. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and does not change the position of parliament, courts or oversight bodies.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34000-C.s: The bill formally sets the 2015 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), fixing the commitment amounts of the general grant at EUR 262,088,000 and of integration and decentralisation grants at EUR 0 and EUR 689,993,000 respectively. It takes effect on 1 January 2015, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant etc. is set for grant year 2015 at EUR 262,088,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2015 vastgesteld op € 262.088.000.

34200-A.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund through technical and bookkeeping adjustments, as set out in the attached schedule. It enters into force the day after publication and takes effect retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34210-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) by adjusting expenditure and commitment amounts across policy articles in the first supplementary budget. It sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 June 2015, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2015 to the departmental budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII).
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2015 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII)

34300-XVII.s: This bill sets the 2016 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, fixing expenditure, commitments and revenue in thousands of euros across five policy articles. The explanatory memorandum describes spending programmes on trade, food security, social progress, peace and security, and multilateral engagement.
q: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2016 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34475-XIII.s: This is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) that amends the 2015 budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, its agencies, and the Animal Health Fund, rounding out the actual outcomes for the year. It sets out figures in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2015 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd

35000-B.s: The bill formally adopts the 2019 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting commitment amounts of about 24.9 billion euros for the general grant and related integration and decentralisation grants for 2019. It enters into force on 1 January 2019, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
35000-B.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget mainly through the evaluation of distribution models and reviews of financial relations between state and municipalities, not through any new delegation of powers.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for the 2019 grant year at €24,888,257,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2019 vastgesteld op € 24.888.257.000.

35200-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) by adjusting the authorised commitments and expenditures and receipts across policy articles, as set out in the attached statement. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2018
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35470-XIV.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) for 2019 amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agency budget of the NVWA, and the Animal Health Fund for that year. It sets the realised amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendments retroactive to 31 December 2019.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35470-XVI.s: This bill is a Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) that amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) and the 2019 budget statement for its agencies, in thousands of euros, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. It does not delegate rule-making power or alter oversight, judicial review or citizens' legal protection.

parties: Asks how much the Minister expects to set aside for the Wlz state contribution in upcoming budgets.
How much does the Minister expect to reserve for the Wlz state contribution in the upcoming budgets?
Hoeveel verwacht de Minister voor de Rijksbijdrage Wlz te reserveren voor de aankomende begrotingen?
Argues the healthcare allowance system leaves too much room for wrongful payments or delayed payments needing later correction, and asks for the amounts repaid by individual insured persons.

As is known, these members favour financing healthcare costs without using the healthcare allowance, since the current system leaves too much room for wrongful payments or non-payment that must later be corrected.

Zoals bekend zijn genoemde leden voorstander van een financiering van de zorgkosten waarbij geen gebruik hoeft te worden gemaakt van zorgtoeslag, aangezien het huidige systeem te veel ruimte biedt voor onterechte uitbetalingen of het uitblijven van een uitbetaling die later hersteld moet worden.

35650-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statutes for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) agency, and the Animal Health Fund, in a second supplementary budget. It is a budget adjustment with no new delegation of rule-making powers, and it sets an effective date of 1 December 2020.
q: We, Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

35650-XVI.s: This second supplementary budget bill for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2020 amends the departmental budget statement, the agency budget statement and the budget fund statement for that year, in thousands of euros, with effect from the day after publication. The explanatory memorandum covers budget reallocations such as a subsidy for a pharmaceutical knowledge centre, a loan and guarantee to Sanquin for a plasma facility, and the adjustment of net care spending against the care expenditure ceiling.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2020 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35688-(R2151).s: The bill amends the Dutch Nationality Act and Passport Act to align them with a new judicial procedure for establishing statelessness in the European Netherlands, adding a naturalisation route for stateless minors born in the Kingdom and allowing the Minister to act without a lawyer in statelessness proceedings. It also withdraws two reservations to the 1954 Statelessness Convention.
35688-(R2151).j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the procedure as a response to an advisory committee report and notes the Minister may already appeal in cassation as an interested party, so the change is procedural.
q: Notwithstanding Article 79 of the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure for the European part of the Netherlands, the Minister may act in court without a lawyer.
In afwijking van artikel 79 van het Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering van het Europese deel van Nederland kan Onze Minister zonder advocaat in rechte optreden.
p: The Minister may act without a lawyer in court in statelessness proceedings, departing from the general rule of the Code of Civil Procedure, while the court still hears the State as interested party.

parties: Asks why the reservations are withdrawn, whether this is necessary, and what the consequences are for other parts of the Kingdom.
Is it necessary for the introduction of this law to withdraw the reservations?
Is het noodzakelijk voor invoering van deze wet de voorbehouden in te trekken?

Argues the ten-year stable residence requirement is too long and takes too distrustful a stance toward the foreign national, citing the Council of State, CRM, UNHCR and ISI; asks the government to adopt the advice and drop the stability condition.

These members request the government to adopt the Council of State's advice to delete the stable residence condition in the proposed article 6(1)(p) and (q) of the RWN and change it to ordinary residence

Deze leden verzoeken de regering het advies van de Afdeling over te nemen dat de voorwaarde van stabiel verblijf in het voorgestelde artikel 6, eerste lid, onder p en q van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap (RWN) te schrappen en te wijzigingen in gewoon verblijf

Says the ten-year stable residence condition unduly limits the option right and is not compatible with the 1961 Convention, following the Council of State and ACVZ advice; asks why the government did not follow it.
In the view of the Council of State's advisory division, this additional condition is not in accordance with article 1 of the 1961 Convention on the Reduction of Statelessness.

Naar de mening van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State (hierna: de Afdeling) is deze aanvullende voorwaarde niet in overeenstemming met artikel 1 van het Verdrag van 1961 tot beperking van de staatloosheid.

Holds that the government imposes requirements beyond the conventions by introducing 'stable' residence and tying it to Dutch migration policy, contrary to the Council of State's advice; asks for the term to be changed to 'gewoon'.

These ChristenUnie members further note that the government fills this concept with conditions from Dutch immigration policy, which are not in line with the 1954 and 1961 conventions and do not follow from them.

Deze leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie constateren bovendien dat de regering dit begrip invult met voorwaarden uit het Nederlandse vreemdelingebeleid, die niet in lijn zijn met de verdragen van 1954 en 1961 en daar ook niet uit volgen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the proposed option right for stateless children born in the Netherlands without lawful residence should replace the requirement of 'stable residence' with 'habitual residence', because the former, including the condition that parents not frustrate departure or evade supervision, goes beyond what Article 1 of the 1961 Convention permits. The government's nader rapport rejected this interpretation, but it nonetheless adjusted the bill by adopting a single option right up to age 21 with at least ten years of stable residence, including five uninterrupted years immediately before the declaration.
concerns: The Afdeling held that the 'stable residence' condition, which excludes parents who frustrated departure or evaded supervision, is not compatible with the 'habitual residence' standard of Article 1 of the 1961 Convention and should be changed to 'habitual residence'.

The Afdeling's advice to align the option regime with the wording of Article 1 of the 1961 Convention was partly followed by restructuring the option right and residence period in line with that text.

35830-XIV.s: This bill (Slotwet 2020) formally amends the 2020 budget statements for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, its agency NVWA, and the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds). It sets out the final budget figures and realised outcomes for that year, without changing any statute.
q: We have approved and resolved, with joint consultation of the States General ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2020 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35830-XVI.s: This Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the 2020 agency budget statement, setting realised expenditure and commitments in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no oversight changes; it only records budget figures.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2020 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this act.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

36100-XVII.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (Slotwet) that amends the 2021 expenditure statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, setting out original, first and second supplementary budgets against realised figures. It finalises the budget adjustments in thousands of euros, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.

36550-XIV.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2024 budget statements of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agencies budget and the Animal Health Fund, mainly raising spending on the NVWA and related supervision after a 2023 court ruling on inspection fees. It makes the changes effective retroactively from 1 June 2024.
36550-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by the need to keep performing statutory tasks and by the consequences of a College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven ruling on inspection costs.
q: This is necessary to be able to keep carrying out the statutory tasks and to grow in line with the development of organic agriculture.
Dit is nodig om de wettelijke taken uit te kunnen blijven voeren en door te groeien in lijn met de ontwikkeling van de biologische landbouw.

36550-XVI.s: This first supplementary budget bill for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS) for 2024 amends the departmental budget statement and the statement for the agencies, mainly by adjusting expenditure and appropriations across policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive effect from 1 June 2024.

36613-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statements for the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature, the agency NVWA, and the Animal Health Fund, adjusting appropriations and receipts. It mainly reallocates funds and raises the NVWA's budget to cover incidental costs of the reform of its inspection system.
q: The budget for the NVWA is increased by EUR 23.2 million.
Het budget voor de NVWA wordt met € 23,2 mln. verhoogd.

36613-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport through a supplementary budget, adjusting spending and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. The explanatory memorandum covers wage and price adjustments, funding for a cannabis coffeeshop experiment and food additive research, and reallocations within several subsidy and transfer lines.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2024 (September supplementary budget)
Wijziging begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2024 (Suppletoire begroting september)

36725-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and its agencies through a first supplementary budget, raising appropriations and commitments for business and innovation policy and the Future Fund. It also adjusts the agency budgets for the Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland, the Dienst ICT Uitvoering and the Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2025.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2025 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd

36820-XIV.s: The bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature, changing appropriations by artikel and giving retroactive effect to 16 September 2025. The explanatory memorandum explains budget shifts, such as postponing funds for the peak-load approach to 2027 and increasing the budget of the Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland.
q: We, Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided, with joint consultation of the States General, that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature for 2025.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

36820-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport through a September supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and expenditures across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 16 September 2025.

36925-(R2219).s: The bill codifies in a Rijkswet the extradition rules for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, previously set out in the Uitleveringsbesluit, covering conditions, procedure, the role of the Governor and the Gemeenschappelijk Hof, and legal assistance. It repeals the Uitleveringsbesluit and amends related instruments, keeping the existing division of competence between the Governor and the court.
36925-(R2219).j: The memorandum justifies codifying the rules in a Rijkswet, as advised by the Raad van State, to satisfy the Statute's requirement that matters be set by law and to avoid standalone administrative regulation.
d: Governor decides whether to grant or refuse extradition
Governor assesses death penalty non-enforcement guarantee
Governor permits transit of extradited person through territory
p: Governor judges whether a discrimination risk or special hardship justifies refusing extradition, a discretionary assessment largely left to the executive.
Governor orders temporary transfer of detained persons to a foreign state for confrontation or testimony without court involvement.

parties: No questions; the fractie has studied the bill and the advice of the Raad van State and the government's reply.
These members currently have no questions on this.
Deze leden hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
No remarks or questions; the fractie looks forward to further treatment of the bill.
They have no remarks or questions and look forward to the further treatment of the bill.
Zij hebben hierbij geen opmerkingen of vragen en kijken uit naar de verdere behandeling van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks why extradition is allowed when a death sentence may be imposed and whether the death penalty exception should be tightened to bar extradition.
Why is the death penalty exception not adjusted so that extradition is not allowed if the death penalty can be imposed?
Waarom wordt de doodstrafexceptie niet dusdanig aangepast dat in geval dat de doodstraf kan worden opgelegd uitlevering niet toegestaan is?
Supports the transfer to a Rijkswet but asks the government to respond to the Curaçao bar's concerns about the governor's position, support and conflict of interest with the prosecutor.
These members ask whether a response can be given to the OvA's concerns about the position of the governor
Deze leden vragen of er een reactie kan komen op de zorgen van de OvA rondom de positie van de gouverneur

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, without substantive remarks, that the draft Rijkswet on extradition for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten be submitted to parliament and the Staten of each country. The minister's reply reports a clarification to article 2.10 on the specialty principle and some clarifications to the explanatory memorandum following advice from the Raad van Advies of Aruba and Curaçao.
